+package ext
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	authrpc "go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+var authMethods = map[string]authrpc.Method{
+	"token":      authrpc.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+	"oidc":       authrpc.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+	"kubernetes": authrpc.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"k8s":        authrpc.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"github":     authrpc.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+	"jwt":        authrpc.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+	"cloud":      authrpc.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+}
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name: "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.A, types.S), types.B),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	inputObject, ok := input.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, errors.New("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	authentication := inputObject.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	authenticationObject, ok := authentication.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, errors.New("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	method := authenticationObject.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	if method == nil {
+		return ast.BooleanTerm(false), nil
+	}
+
+	methodName, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %v", key.Value)
+	}
+
+	expectedMethod, ok := authMethods[string(methodName)]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", string(methodName))
+	}
+
+	methodNumber, ok := method.Value.(ast.Number)
+	if !ok {
+		return ast.BooleanTerm(false), nil
+	}
+
+	methodValue, ok := methodNumber.Int64()
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(ok && methodValue == int64(expectedMethod)), nil
+}

+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	authrpc "go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		method string
+		code   authrpc.Method
+	}{
+		{name: "token", method: "token", code: authrpc.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
+		{name: "oidc", method: "oidc", code: authrpc.Method_METHOD_OIDC},
+		{name: "kubernetes", method: "kubernetes", code: authrpc.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{name: "k8s alias", method: "k8s", code: authrpc.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{name: "github", method: "github", code: authrpc.Method_METHOD_GITHUB},
+		{name: "jwt", method: "jwt", code: authrpc.Method_METHOD_JWT},
+		{name: "cloud", method: "cloud", code: authrpc.Method_METHOD_CLOUD},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			result, err := callIsAuthMethod(t, int32(tt.code), tt.method)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.Boolean(true), result.Value)
+
+			result, err = callIsAuthMethod(t, int32(authrpc.Method_METHOD_NONE), tt.method)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.Boolean(false), result.Value)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	inputValue, err := ast.InterfaceToValue(map[string]interface{}{})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.NewTerm(inputValue), ast.StringTerm("token"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	result, err := callIsAuthMethod(t, int32(authrpc.Method_METHOD_TOKEN), "unsupported")
+	require.Nil(t, result)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported auth method: unsupported")
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodRegisteredWithRego(t *testing.T) {
+	query, err := rego.New(
+		rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "jwt")`),
+		rego.Input(map[string]interface{}{
+			"authentication": map[string]interface{}{
+				"method": int32(authrpc.Method_METHOD_JWT),
+			},
+		}),
+		rego.StrictBuiltinErrors(true),
+	).Eval(context.Background())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Len(t, query, 1)
+	require.Equal(t, true, query[0].Expressions[0].Value)
+}
+
+func callIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T, methodCode int32, methodName string) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	inputValue, err := ast.InterfaceToValue(map[string]interface{}{
+		"authentication": map[string]interface{}{
+			"method": methodCode,
+		},
+	})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	return isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.NewTerm(inputValue), ast.StringTerm(methodName))
+}
